facts.fact: The four Labour Codes are in force from 21 November 2025
facts.quote: the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Code on Social Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 are being made effective from 21st November 2025 , rationalising 29 existing labour laws.

summary: Decline-opinion case; the one fact offered (Codes in force from 21 Nov 2025) is confirmed by PIB.
